Rooms.Name: Entrance Hall
Rooms.Description: A grand hall with a dusty chandelier. The main door is sealed shut.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: Rows of ancient books line the walls. A faint smell of vanilla hangs in the air.

Rooms.Name: Garden
Rooms.Description: A once beautiful garden, now overgrown with thorny vines.

NPCs.Name: Old Man
NPCs.Dialog: Greetings, traveler. This castle has been empty for a long time... or has it?

NPCs.Name: Ghost
NPCs.Dialog: Woooo... who dares disturb my slumber?
